description: This file manages the registration and communication with an ECMAScript Module (ESM) loader, handling tasks such as starting/stopping file dependency collection, incorporating compilation cache, and configuring the loader with TypeScript and transformation configurations. It sets up a MessageChannel for inter-process or inter-module communication related to module loading and transformation caching within the Playwright project.

classes.name: PortTransport
classes.description: A class handling message transport over a MessagePort, used for communication between the loader and the main process, including callback handling for specific methods.

methods.name: export function registerESMLoader() { registerESMLoader
methods.description: Registers the ES module loader by setting up a message channel and invoking Node's module registration hook unless certain environment conditions prevent it.

methods.name: function createPortTransport(port: MessagePort) { createPortTransport
methods.description: Creates an instance of PortTransport for a given MessagePort, with a callback that specifically handles 'pushToCompilationCache' method invocation.

methods.name: export async function startCollectingFileDeps() { startCollectingFileDeps
methods.description: Instructs the loader to start collecting file dependencies.

methods.name: export async function stopCollectingFileDeps(file: string) { stopCollectingFileDeps
methods.description: Instructs the loader to stop collecting file dependencies for a specific file.

methods.name: export async function incorporateCompilationCache() { incorporateCompilationCache
methods.description: Retrieves and integrates the latest compilation cache from the loader to maintain dependency information.

methods.name: export async function configureESMLoader() { configureESMLoader
methods.description: Configures the ESM loader with the default TypeScript configuration and current compilation cache.

methods.name: export async function configureESMLoaderTransformConfig() { configureESMLoaderTransformConfig
methods.description: Configures the ESM loader with the default TypeScript configuration and specific transformation settings.
